messages:
Lina: Quick sync - planning a 30m change window 03:30 UTC to enable new header routing key + runtime KV eviction policy 'aggressive'. Need API pins and console parser fallback ready.
Tom: Can you share exact rollback signal? I'll pin API routes if we agree.
Ravi: Runtime ops: flip is a single flag toggle. Eviction 'aggressive' increases evict_rate; safe rollback is flip back and pause traffic for 10m to let caches repop.
Lina: Plan: start 3:30 UTC. Canary 3% global for 8m, then 25% for 10m, then full. Auto-rollback triggers: p95 >250ms OR 5xx rate >0.8% OR kv_eviction_count >400/min spike.
DeployBot: deploybot: schedule created 'hdr-kv-aggressive-2024' at 2024-09-17T03:30Z by Lina. Canary=3%. Status: scheduled.
Tom: I'll pin api-gateway routes to v1.5.0 for 45m after full ramp. @DeployBot please wait for console_canary_ok.
DeployBot: deploybot: hold set by Tom: hold-until=console_canary_ok
Ravi: Runtime curl to flip: ```
curl -X POST https://ops/api/runtime/flags \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" \
 -d '{"kv_policy":"aggressive", "kv_eviction":true}'
```
Lina: Console team: can you deploy parser canary 2m after runtime canary start and report parse-failure rate?
Tom: Gate: if embedding mismatch >0.7% across sampled requests, abort.
ci-bot: perf-check: created temp dashboard https://dash/quick/rel-1788889990, alerting rules applied.
Ravi: Rollback curl: ```
# rollback runtime flags
curl -X POST https://ops/api/runtime/flags \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" \
 -d '{"kv_policy":"standard", "kv_eviction":false}'
```
DeployBot: deploybot: canary started (sim). status=canary_running ts=1788889992
Tom: Console canary OK — parser-failures 0.02% over 5m. Removing hold.
DeployBot: deploybot: hold removed by Tom (console_canary_ok). Starting ramp to 25%.
ci-bot: monitor: p95=120ms, errors=0.1%, kv_eviction_count=30/min. All green.
Lina: Good. Proceed to 100% in 10m. I'll update the internal relnotes: https://redwood-internal/notes/hdr-kv-1788.md
Tom: Added API note and SDK follow-up ticket.
Ravi: All done, no rollback. Closing window.
